summary: Climber fell ~100 ft onto a 30-40 ft ledge at Devils Head; DCSAR hiked ~1.5 mi in, lowered the subject off the ledge to staged medical personnel, and Air Life transported them to a hospital by helicopter; extent of injuries unreported
location: Devils Head, Rampart Range, Pike National Forest (~14 mi SW of Sedalia)
responding_agency: Douglas County Sheriff deputies + Douglas County SAR; Jackson 105 FD, Larkspur FD, Castle Rock FD, USFS, Air Life
notes: DCSO release published 2017-06-18 (response at 3:27 p.m. Sunday); subject was part of a group of climbers scaling Devils Head, cause of fall unknown; resolves the run-235 Devils Head pending lead. Full release opened via browser task.
